items.title: Voter list correction window closes 30 September
items.what_happened: Delhi SIR: 4.77M names out of draft voter roll. Claims till 30 Sep 2026.
items.why_matters: Miss it and name stays off till next revision.
items.source: Business Standard (31 Aug), Election office (19 Sep)

items.title: TPDDL power shutdown 22–23 September
items.what_happened: Model Town Circle shutdown 10:30–12:30 on 22 and 23 Sep.
items.why_matters: Daytime cuts affect lifts, pumps, WFH.

items.title: Dengue peak: 121 cases in September
items.what_happened: MCD report: 432 dengue in Delhi 2026. Sept is worst month.
items.why_matters: Peak dengue season. Coolers, sumps are breeding grounds.
items.action: Empty coolers weekly. Report via MCD 311 app.
